base_member_text: [L1280-L1337] (HIGH/uninitialized directional-bin indices) Nbin is never initialized, and a direction shifted once by 2π can still fall outside a computational sector narrower than 2π, leaving its bin entry undefined before maxval and nspr handling.

audit_member_text: [L1789-L1794] (HIGH/vector rotation) Curvilinear flux rotation derives direction with atan(qy/max(qx,eps)), which clamps negative qx and cannot preserve the correct quadrant.

dispositions.rationale: span-refuted: LINEAR_INTERP clamps a query below its first abscissa to y(1), rather than extrapolating (interp.F90:135-140). Thus a draw below P(1) returns theta(1), and the explicit equality branch at 1163-1164 assigns stepang=1, neutralizing the claimed column-zero path.

audit_member_text: [L1367-L1457] (HIGH/order-dependent physics) The total envelope and directional weights are computed inside the directional-bin loop before later bins' zeta values exist, so Ampzeta for early bins depends on processing order and omits later directional components.
dispositions.rationale: span-confirmed: zeta is zero-initialized and populated one directional bin at a time, but eta and Ampzeta are computed inside that same bin loop. Later bins are still zero when an early bin is weighted, and the non-symmetric output branch at 1507-1509 uses those unrecomputed Ampzeta values.
